title: 第17章 我现在是合欢谷谷主第18章 她们争着与我双修共享永生大道
content_zh:
虫洞是真方便，一步就从玄木星跨到了玄水星。
最明显的感觉，是体重一下子增加了30%。
这又勾起了我对物理的执念。
真不知道什么时候，我翌恒宗也能掌握六级科技文明的技术。
香茹说最快的办法，是找一位天幕星美女做伴侣，为了避免学科有遗漏，还得多找几位才稳妥。
天幕星文明，正是宇宙中唯一的六级科技文明。
……
我要以霜颜朵的身份进入合欢谷，得先变成她的容貌。
有菁秀辅助，估计几天就能搞定。
菁秀已经基本复制了霜颜朵肉身留下的所有记忆。
只是记忆并不完整，或许部分记忆是由灵体承载的。
而她的灵体现在是“我的阴阳世界”的器奴，并没有留下任何记忆。
我让一珉把所有记忆系统分析了一遍。
她认为关键信息记忆深刻，并没有明显缺失，缺少的主要是生活琐事。
这倒没什么好担心的，一珉会一直在“灵玉空间”里辅助我的行动。
我最担心的，是自己没有水灵体，也没法施展水灵体的天赋技能。
转念一想，合欢谷主打双修，灵体其实也没那么重要。
……
容羞定了规矩，进入“灵玉空间”只允许两种情况：
一是把身心彻底交给我，成为我的双修伴侣；

二是被“纳生”等强行拉入，囚禁在里面。
交心自然是与我激活“阴阳同梦”；
交身则有多种方式，比如融合“本命阳玉”给我，或是“血脉融合”成为我的灵奴，也可以激活“灵魂契约”成为我的附属伴侣，又或是激活“阴阳调息”成为我的阴阳伴侣。
几天后，诗师成功凝聚了“本命玉”，最后一个进入“灵玉空间”。
一切准备就绪，我终于可以出发了。
没想到路上居然碰到了一个认识的人——阴霸天。
颜朵的记忆里并没有他，他却叫我“师姐”，应该是不久前才加入合欢谷的。
看来菁缨离开玄水星后，他是真的心灰意冷了。
更没想到的是，在入谷的大门口，居然又碰到了另外一对认识的人——速芬宁和速芳宁。
她们虽然戴了面纱，但婧容能复制她们的身形，我一眼就认出了她们。
奇怪了，她们怎么知道我来了这里？
除非她们能“预感”到我的行踪。
她们正在挨个检查进入谷中的男人。
阴霸天因为弄了个假胡子，结果头发、眉毛都被硬生生拔光，头上一片血肉模糊，真是倒大霉了。
好好的非要装成熟，弄什么假胡子呢？
我本来还有些担心，可轮到我时，双胞胎看都没看我一眼，就放我过去了。
“站住！”
我刚走没几步，就被双胞胎叫住了。
难道她们发现了什么？
“两位姐姐？”我试探着问。

“过来，帮我们检查。”
原来她们是累了，想让我帮忙代劳。
说着，她们拿出一幅全息画，上面画的正是我本来的容貌，还是旋转的，360度无死角。
奇怪了，画中的我一件衣服都没有，她们是从哪里弄到我的身形的？
content_en:
The wormhole is so convenient, you can go from Xuan Jupiter to Xuan Shui in one step.
The most obvious feeling is that my weight suddenly increased by 30%.
This revived my obsession with physics.
I really don’t know when I, Hengzong, will also be able to master the technology of the sixth-level scientific and technological civilization.
Xiangru said that the fastest way is to find a beautiful girl from Tianmu Star as a partner. In order to avoid omissions in subjects, it is safe to find a few more.
The Tianmu Star civilization is the only level six technological civilization in the universe.
…
If I want to enter Hehuan Valley as Shuang Yanduo, I must first change into her appearance.
With Jingxiu's help, it can be done in a few days.
Jingxiu has basically copied all the memories left by Shuang Yanduo's body.
It's just that the memory is not complete, maybe part of the memory is carried by the spirit body.
And her spirit body is now a slave of "my Yin and Yang World" and has left no memory.
I asked Yimin to analyze all the memory systems.
She believes that key information is deeply remembered and is not obviously missing. What is missing is mainly trivial matters in life.
There's nothing to worry about. Yimin will always be assisting me in my actions in the "Spiritual Jade Space".
What I'm most worried about is that I don't have a water spirit body, and I can't use the water spirit body's natural skills.
Then I thought about it, Hehuan Valley focuses on dual cultivation, and the spiritual body is actually not that important.
…
Rong Xi set the rules and only allowed two situations to enter the "Ling Jade Space":
First, give your body and mind to me completely and become my dual cultivation partner;
The second is that they were forcibly pulled in by "Nasheng" and others and imprisoned inside.
Heart-to-heart communication naturally activates the "yin and yang dream" with me;
There are many ways to get involved, such as merging "Original Yang Jade" to me, or "bloodline fusion" to become my spiritual slave, activating "Soul Contract" to become my affiliated partner, or activating "Yin Yang Breath Regulation" to become my yin and yang partner.
A few days later, the poet successfully condensed the "birth jade" and was the last one to enter the "spiritual jade space".
Everything was ready and I was finally ready to go.
Unexpectedly, he met someone he knew on the road - Yin Batian.
There is no him in Yan Duo's memory, but he calls me "senior sister". He must have joined Hehuan Valley not long ago.
It seemed that he was really disheartened after Jingying left Xuanshui Star.
What was even more unexpected was that at the entrance to the valley, I met another pair of familiar people - Su Fenning and Su Fangning.
Although they wore veils, Jingrong could copy their figures, and I recognized them at a glance.
It's strange, how did they know I was here?
Unless they can "foresee" my whereabouts.
They were checking the men entering the valley one by one.
Because Yin Batian got a fake beard, his hair and eyebrows were all plucked out, and his head was a bloody mess. He was really unlucky.
If you have to pretend to be mature, why should you get a fake beard?
I was a little worried at first, but when it was my turn, the twins let me pass without even looking at me.
"Stop!"
I had just taken a few steps when the twins stopped me.
Did they discover something?
"Two sisters?" I asked tentatively.
"Come here and check it for us."
It turned out that they were tired and wanted me to help them.
As they said that, they took out a holographic painting, which showed my original appearance, and it was rotating, with no blind spots in 360 degrees.
It’s strange, I don’t have any clothes on in the painting. Where did they get my figure?
